candidate: First substantive C5 source passing directed correctness; commit exact runtime and record both commit and runtime SHA256 before the sole invocation.
query_order: Same deterministic fixed order for each source pair; record every original query ID in every worker.
cache: Native MemoryBook cache_size=0 and use_cache=False. Derived exact-token-count memo is enabled with fixed 2048-entry/2MiB text-object limits, initially empty per new connection and naturally retained across native configurations. No extra prewarming or discarded queries. Save read-only before/after memo diagnostics.
timing: Complete native recall, excluding post-call hash validation. Fresh worker per source/cohort/round; retain all cells, calls, errors and adverse results.
correctness: Every complete payload except latency_ms matches the published baseline. Unchanged source/index projections and exact count/invariant checks from the retained development helper.
attempt_policy: One registered invocation for this substantive C5 source. Preserve every adverse row. A substantive correctness fix requires a new explicitly identified attempt.
decision_boundary: Development diagnosis on old regression cohorts, not formal release acceptance, an MCP timing result, competitor timing or new quality. The separate 56784-call bound run must pass every original gate.
